body:
PR #2760 (TASK-1959): trace-gate leak root-caused, fixed, pushed at 3a3cb2a103252bf2d1e17fa431976c02a37c1787.

Culprit: NOT an aida-cli integration binary. It is the aida-cli-lib unit test
  task_1486_store_refusal_tests::agent_block_for_other_errors_keeps_the_single_help_shape
(aida-cli-lib/src/tests/task_1486_store_refusal_tests.rs; cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib).
It calls agent_error_block() with a "Requirement not found: NOSUCH-1" message. That reaches
did_you_mean_for_not_found -> known_spec_ids_for_suggestion(<checkout root>), which unconditionally
ran load_dispenser + GitBackend::new on <root>/.aida-store. Those scaffold objects/ and
.aida/dispenser.toml. Result: a PLAIN .aida-store/ at the checkout root, so the gate's
`git -C .aida-store` resolves to the checkout, `reset --hard origin/aida-store` resets the checkout
itself, and the gate finds no store.

Why main passes: on main, aida-cli's agent_error_channel ran `aida show NOSUCH-1` from the crate dir.
In CI that takes 40s (on this branch, 0.05s) because it fresh-clone AUTO-ATTACHES a real
.aida-store worktree. The aida-cli package runs before aida-cli-lib, so the unit test's write landed
harmlessly inside that real worktree. Proof: on green run 39315760508 the gate fetch shows
`5467746aba..33dcfa40bb aida-store -> origin/aida-store` (already fetched by the attach). On
failing run 39332532907 it shows `[new branch]`. My earlier hermeticizing of agent_error_channel
removed the mask. Main's trace gate has silently depended on that test's side effect.

Repro: clone with every ref except the PR head removed (CI-shaped: no origin/aida-store). The eight
changed binaries, the 21 bash steps before test_distributed.sh, test_isolated_home_guard and the bwrap
step were all clean. aida-cli-lib --lib created .aida-store/{objects,.aida/dispenser.toml}. Bisected
with filters to that one test, which reproduces alone with --exact.

Fix (production + test):
- rel_cards.rs known_spec_ids_for_suggestion: return empty unless store_locate::is_store_attached(root)
  (the documented read-only contract). A typo'd `aida show` in a real fresh clone also scaffolded it.
- New regression test task_1082_did_you_mean_tests::suggestion_lookup_never_scaffolds_an_unattached_store.
  It fails before the fix and passes after.
- test_distributed.sh: under CI, FAIL at start if .aida-store already exists (verified it fires).
- CheckoutGuard (aida-cli/tests/support) was never static. It is a per-test/per-fixture RAII field, so
  Drop runs. It was silent because the writer was a lib unit test, outside any guarded binary.

Gate: check-ci-fast ok (31 gates); cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib task_1486 + task_1082 ok (15);
test_distributed.sh ok; check-ci-compile ok. In the CI-shaped clone after the fix: no .aida-store, and a
plain `git worktree add` + `aida trace gate` passes.

Watch-out: on this branch nothing auto-attaches before the gate any more, so the gate takes its
`git worktree add` path (as designed). Not merged/shipped by me.
subject: PR #2760 trace-gate leak: culprit + fix @ 3a3cb2a103
